To tell 55 % apart from a coin you need about 380 trades. Until then your equity curve is a sample.

How many trades did it take before you trusted your numbers? 👇

Halve your size after 3 losses and a 10-loss streak costs 12 % instead of 18 %.

Getting back from −12 % needs +14 %. Getting back from −18 % needs +22 %. Sizing down when you are cold is the one rule that pays you during a streak.

eintraege.titel: Risk $500 a trade on $10,000 and 20 losses is zero. Risk 5 % and 20 losses leaves $3,600.
eintraege.text:
Risk $500 a trade on $10,000 and 20 losses is zero. Risk 5 % and 20 losses leaves $3,600.

20 × $500 is the whole $10,000. Loss number 20 takes the last of it. At 5 % of what is left, the risk shrinks with the account: loss number 20 costs $190, and there is a trade number 21.

Same 20 losses. One trader is out of the game, the other is down and still playing. A fixed percent can shrink you. It can never finish you.

Send this to the friend who risks "the same 500 as always".

Fixed amount or fixed percent, which one do you use? 👇

eintraege.titel: Take out your single best trade and the year is red.
eintraege.text:
Take out your single best trade and the year is red.

200 trades, +20R for the year. The best one of them made +25R. Without that one trade the other 199 add up to −5R.

One trade out of 200 decides the sign of your year. That is luck, and luck does not compound. A track record is only as strong as it is without its best trade.

Send this to the friend whose "system" is one big winner from March.

What does your year look like without your best trade? 👇

eintraege.titel: 60 % win rate over 50 trades. A coin does that one time in ten.
eintraege.text:
60 % win rate over 50 trades. A coin does that one time in ten.

30 winners out of 50 feels like an edge. Flip a coin 50 times and 30 or more heads shows up in about 1 run out of 10. Put 10 traders with no edge in a room, 50 trades each, and one of them will show you a 60 % track record.

To be sure it is your edge and not the coin, you need about 100 trades at 60 %, or about 380 at 55 %. 50 trades is a story. 200 is a statistic.

Send this to the friend who went live after a 50-trade backtest.

How many trades did your first "edge" survive? 👇
